data.one_liner: Generate strong random passwords and estimate password strength in Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a utility class to generate random passwords with customizable character constraints and check password strength. It evaluates passwords and returns a numerical strength score.
use_when: You need to generate secure random passwords programmatically.
You need to evaluate password strength within your app.
avoid_when: You require complex rule-based enterprise password validators.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for generating passwords.
Includes a built-in password strength checker.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Minimal documentation and features beyond basic generation and strength checking.

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need unique identifiers rather than human-readable passwords.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need cryptographic hash functions instead of password generation.
